description: NASA/JPL Sentry impact-risk table entries as published. These are computed estimates: the stated probability can easily be inaccurate by a factor of a few, and almost every object listed will not hit Earth. Not an official alerting channel. Free. Unaltered copy of the issuer's own notice with the issuer's name and times; ArrowMem adds no assessment.

designation.description: An object designation as Sentry lists it, for example 101955.

name: get_asteroid_impact_risk
